items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: So I said, okay, Babe, let's go on down and open up at the Playhouse.

ctx.x: Very nice piano player. I was surprised because Babe was a very good basketball player. We -- all the kids came along playing basketball, and he must have studied after I left Chicago because Cassino Simpson and all of us guys went to school together. But Babe, we all went to school together too. But Babe wasn't in music at that particular time.

So when he came to New York, I was surprised at him because then he started looking for me. So then I found out he was a little, nice piano player. So I said, okay, Babe, let's go on down and open up at the Playhouse.
Well now, I mean did you just -- did your group just play there, or did that become a place like it did in later years, where people came to sit in?
